title: Authentication request path
description: A small example showing how a request moves from routing through authentication and into the handler.

nodes.title: Request processing
nodes.comment: Start with the main request lifecycle before drilling into the authentication branch.

children.title: Request entry point
children.comment: Incoming requests are normalized here before routing. Identify the request object passed to the next phase.

children.title: Route selection
children.comment: The route is resolved here. Authentication behavior is selected from route metadata rather than inside each handler.

children.title: Authentication gate
children.comment: Credentials are checked before dispatch. Pay attention to the state returned on authentication failure.

children.title: Handler dispatch
children.comment: After authentication succeeds, the selected handler receives the normalized request and identity.
